milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the redstone wall torches and face them to demonstrate they have 'found' them. Target is the torch location at spawn-relative (-3, 0, 7). Max distance of 8 blocks ensures the player has entered the alcove, and facing_tolerance of 60 degrees ensures they are looking toward the torches.

Uses inventory_has because mining a potted_red_tulip block drops a flower_pot item into the player's inventory. There are no other flower pots in the scene, so having one in inventory is a reliable signal that the potted_red_tulip was mined. No tool is required to break flower pots.
